groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about how seed banks store and check plant seeds.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
GETTING A WILD SEED SAMPLE INTO A SEED BANK

IN THE FIELD
Not more than a fifth of the ripe seed is taken, and the seed of every plant
is kept (1) ........ all the way to the store
↓
DRYING
Slow drying in a warm, dry room brings the seed down to about five per cent moisture
↓
SEALING AND FREEZING
The quality of the seal counts for more than the jar itself; the agreed
temperature has been minus (2) ........ degrees for years now
↓
CHECKING
X-ray picks out the hollow seeds, then two hundred of them are germinated
↓
RETESTING
If a later test falls short, the sample is grown on and a bigger crop is taken —
the step banks call (3) ........
↓
DUPLICATION
A portion put aside at the start travels to a (4) ........, in another country
if that can be managed

items.prompt: Not more than a fifth of the ripe seed is taken, and the seed of every plant is kept (1) ........ all the way to the store
items.evidence: keep the seed from each plant separate until it reaches the store
items.explanation: Arazide toplanan tohumlar bitki bitki ayrı tutuluyor; birleştirme ancak malzeme depoya ulaştıktan sonra söz konusu oluyor.

items.prompt: The quality of the seal counts for more than the jar itself; the agreed temperature has been minus (2) ........ degrees for years now
items.evidence: the standard storage temperature is minus twenty degrees
items.explanation: Eski ev tipi dondurucu değeri olan eksi on sekiz hâlâ alıntılanıyor; ancak uluslararası standart yıllar önce eksi yirmiye geçti.

items.prompt: If a later test falls short, the sample is grown on and a bigger crop is taken — the step banks call (3) ........
items.explanation: Yeniden test eşiğin altında kalınca kalan tohum ekilip daha büyük bir parti hasat ediliyor; konuşmacı bu adımın adını regeneration olarak veriyor.

items.prompt: A portion put aside at the start travels to a (4) ........, in another country if that can be managed
items.evidence: a duplicate goes to a second site, in a different country wherever that can be arranged
items.explanation: Yedek kopya aynı binada tutulmuyor; baştan ayrılan paket, mümkünse başka bir ülkedeki ikinci bir merkeze gönderiliyor.

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer talking about plastics in the sea and about how they are measured.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
PLASTIC IN THE SEA: WHAT GOES IN, WHAT WE FIND

ANNUAL INPUT
Revised upwards once better waste figures became available
↓
SURFACE SEARCH
Everything floating that surveys can locate adds up to something like
(5) ........ per cent of the estimated input
↓
BREAK-UP
Daylight and moving water turn the polymer (6) ........, so the pieces keep
getting smaller; a coat of organisms then weighs each piece down until it sinks
↓
SAMPLING
A net is towed alongside the vessel. The finer nets now in use,
(7) ........ of a millimetre, return several times as many particles
↓
WHAT WOULD HELP FIRST
Design: with fewer different polymers in one item, (8) ........ becomes practicable

items.prompt: Everything floating that surveys can locate adds up to something like (5) ........ per cent of the estimated input
items.evidence: accounts for perhaps one per cent of what we think has gone in
items.explanation: Denize girdiği tahmin edilen miktarla yüzeyde bulunabilen miktar arasındaki uçurum büyük: yüzen plastik tahminin ancak yüzde biri kadar.

items.prompt: Daylight and moving water turn the polymer (6) ........, so the pieces keep getting smaller
items.evidence: Sunlight and wave action make the polymer brittle, so it breaks into smaller pieces.
items.explanation: Güneş ışığı ve dalga hareketi polimeri kırılgan hâle getiriyor; parça bu yüzden giderek daha küçük parçalara ayrılıyor.

items.prompt: The finer nets now in use, (7) ........ of a millimetre, return several times as many particles
items.evidence: A good deal of recent work uses a tenth
items.explanation: Çoğu araştırmanın kullandığı ağ gözü milimetrenin üçte biri; son yıllardaki çalışmalar onda birlik ağ kullanıyor ve metreküpte kat kat fazla parçacık buluyor.

items.prompt: Design: with fewer different polymers in one item, (8) ........ becomes practicable
items.evidence: so that sorting is possible at all
items.explanation: Konuşmacının en çok güvendiği önlem tasarım: bir üründeki polimer sayısı azalırsa ayrıştırma ancak o zaman mümkün oluyor.

groups.context_line: You will hear part of a lecture about noise pollution, how it is measured and how it can be reduced.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
ROAD NOISE: FROM MAP TO REMEDY

STRATEGIC MAP
Predicted rather than measured: among the figures fed in are vehicle numbers,
speeds, building heights and ground (9) ........
↓
WHERE THE SOUND COMES FROM
Under about forty kilometres an hour it is the engine; faster than that it is
the (10) ........ running over the road surface
↓
AT THE SOURCE
Open-textured asphalt: (11) ........ to four decibels on a road that is no longer new
A limit dropped from fifty to thirty buys two to three decibels for almost nothing
↓
ALONG THE PATH
A wall or an earth bund, set where it hides the wheels from view
↓
AT THE RECEIVER
Secondary glazing helps until a hot night, when the (12) ........ is opened again
and the outlay is thrown away

items.prompt: Predicted rather than measured: among the figures fed in are vehicle numbers, speeds, building heights and ground (9) ........
items.evidence: traffic counts, speeds, the heights of the buildings and the hardness of the ground
items.explanation: Gürültü haritaları ölçümle değil modelle üretiliyor; modele verilen girdiler arasında trafik sayımları, hızlar, bina yükseklikleri ve zeminin sertliği yer alıyor.

items.prompt: Under about forty kilometres an hour it is the engine; faster than that it is the (10) ........ running over the road surface
items.evidence: the dominant source is the contact between the tyre and the road surface
items.explanation: Düşük hızda duyulan şey motor ve egzoz; bu hızın üstünde baskın kaynak lastikle yol yüzeyinin teması oluyor.

items.prompt: Open-textured asphalt: (11) ........ to four decibels on a road that is no longer new
items.evidence: three to four is a more honest figure
items.explanation: Gözenekli asfalt için beş desibel yazılıyor; gözenekler dolduktan sonra gerçekçi kazanç üç ilâ dört desibele iniyor.

items.prompt: Secondary glazing helps until a hot night, when the (12) ........ is opened again and the outlay is thrown away
items.evidence: the window gets opened and everything that was paid for is lost
items.explanation: Yalıtımlı ikinci cam işe yarıyor; ama sıcak havada pencere açıldığı için ödenen paranın karşılığı kayboluyor.

groups.context_line: You will hear a lecturer talking about behavioural economics and how findings from it are tested in the field.
groups.instructions: Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
groups.word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.stem_block:
FROM A LABORATORY FINDING TO A TESTED POLICY

THE DEFAULT
Automatic enrolment lifts membership of a workplace saving scheme sharply,
though the paperwork is identical in both directions
↓
WHY IT WORKS — THREE SEPARATE REASONS
1 (13) ........ : even the smallest obstacle cuts down how many people come through
2 the quiet message that this is what is normally done
3 the form put off, and then put off again
↓
EARLY EVIDENCE
The fifteen-point rise that the papers printed rests on one (14) ........ in a single town
↓
THE METHOD NOW
A field experiment on real customers, allocated at random to one wording or
another, with samples running into (15) ........ of thousands

items.prompt: 1 (13) ........ : even the smallest obstacle cuts down how many people come through
items.evidence: The first is effort: any small obstacle, however trivial, thins out the people who get to the other side of it.
items.explanation: Bir formun bu kadar fark yaratmasının ilk nedeni çaba: ne kadar önemsiz olursa olsun her küçük engel karşıya geçenlerin sayısını azaltıyor.

items.prompt: The fifteen-point rise that the papers printed rests on one (14) ........ in a single town
items.evidence: which came from a single pilot in one town
items.explanation: Gazetelere yansıyan on beş puanlık artış tek bir kasabadaki tek bir pilot çalışmadan geliyor; daha geniş denemelerde etki çok daha küçük çıkıyor.

items.prompt: A field experiment on real customers, allocated at random to one wording or another, with samples running into (15) ........ of thousands
items.evidence: with sample sizes in the tens of thousands
items.explanation: Alanı değiştiren yöntem saha deneyi: örneklem büyüklükleri on binlerle ölçülüyor, erken laboratuvar çalışmalarındaki altmış öğrenciyle değil.
